America is a young country, but one full of opportunity and the ability to stake your claim and become rich and not one the creatures of the forest and fantasy ignore. For years they have run the criminal underworld from the shadows, nothing happened without the approval of the elves or the protection of the trolls, no one has ever questioned the rule of those who wield magic until now.. .  The Board The  Fea  keep to themselves, mostly by race, however once a month, they meet a representative of each family  to make decisions and steer the country from the shadows .  Benny  Goldman Young  Gangster Benny grew up in the Jewish neighborhood of Baltimore and at the age of thirteen he took his bar mitzvah money and lent it out, getting a  descend  return, he built a  thriving  loan shark business, even hiring the ,muscle to ensure he would collect, that was until the  fea  muscled him out, now he is looking to bring down the oldest crime family in the world,  its  going to take magic, luck and some interesting frien ds .
